messages:
Alicia: FYI — saw ~12 GPU-related alerts between 02:10-02:45 UTC that paged oncall. Most were single-request OOMs on inference nodes, not full cluster outages.
Ben: Ugh. Were they all same model/job or spread out?
Alicia: spread across 5 jobs, but 9/12 were from the same node pool and tied to high sequence lengths. Logs: `OOM killed process llm_worker pid=1423 mem=220GB`.
Carla: Thanks — that's the classic noisy-pager pattern. We should tighten paging rules so single OOM spikes create a ticket, not a page.
Dan: Agreed. Suggestion: only page when 
  - sustained errors for >= 5m AND
  - >= 3 distinct nodes report errors OR
  - error_rate > 20% of requests for a job over 5m.
Carla: That feels sane. Also add grouping by `job` + `region` so paging gives context, not 12 duplicate pages.
Ben: Can you drop a PromQL snippet? I can try patching the alerting rule.
Carla: Sure — rough starter:
```
# count of oom events per node over 5m
sum by (node) (increase(node_gpu_oom_total[5m]))

# high-error-rate per job
(sum by(job) (increase(job_request_errors_total[5m]))) / (sum by(job) (increase(job_requests_total[5m])))
```
Then the rule: page if `(sum by(job) (increase(job_request_errors_total[5m])) / sum by(job) (increase(job_requests_total[5m]))) > 0.2 and sum by(job) (increase(job_request_errors_total[5m])) > 50` OR `sum by(node) (increase(node_gpu_oom_total[5m])) >= 3`
Ben: Nice. Let's also add a `for: 5m` to the firing condition in Alertmanager / Prometheus so it needs to persist.
Emily: Can we add an exception for non-prod node pools? We don't want to wake folks for staging flakiness.
Alicia: Yes — rule should include `cluster_env != "prod"` to suppress pages; instead create low-priority tickets for non-prod.
Dan: Another thing — mute windows are useful but risky. Instead I propose routing: pages during oncall hours, otherwise create tickets and send Slack alert to #eng-sre-monitoring.
Carla: Also add de-duplication/group_interval in Alertmanager to 10m to prevent page storms if metric keeps flapping.
Ben: Implementation plan:
  1) Add updated Prometheus rule (for: 5m, job & node grouping, prod-only page label).
  2) Tweak Alertmanager: group_by=["job","region"], group_interval=10m, repeat_interval=2h, route to page only when `severity="page"`.
  3) Add a Grafana panel to show "sustained OOMs" per job in last 24h so SEs can debug.
Alicia: I'll draft the rule PR tonight and tag @oncall for review.
ops-bot: DeployBot: New PR opened by Alicia: "alerting: sustain/oom-rule-guardrails" (#3872)
Ben: Quick UX note — include a `summary` annotation with impacted jobs/nodes, and `runbook` link to the playbook so paged engineer triages faster.
Carla: Good call. Also add `impact: paging` label only when node_count >=3 — otherwise label as `severity: ticket` so it goes to the queue.
Emily: Anything about cost signal? If model runs with extreme seq length regularly, ops should flag to product for batching/limits.
Alicia: Added to PR description: "recommend throttling or sequence-length caps for runaway jobs".
Dan: OK, sounds like consensus. When PR is merged, let's monitor for 48h and iterate.
Ben: I'll add a dashboard alert for paging reductions — want to validate we're not hiding real incidents.
Alicia: Thanks all. Action items: PR (Alicia), AM config (Ben), Grafana panel (Carla), runbook update (Ben/Emily).
Carla: :thumbsup:
Ben: :+1:
Emily: :rocket:
